options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Starting Locked Letter Count
options.doc:
The number of letters that will be locked at the start of the multiworld.
The higher the value, the more letters will be unable to spawn by default. The letters are chosen at random.
In order to unlock a locked letter, its respective 'Letter Unlock:' item must be received.
The randomiser has built-in rules to make sure that your starting letter pool is fair and reasonably playable.

options.name: Nexus Charge Percentage
options.doc:
The percentage of items in the item pool that will end up being Nexus Charges.
Default is 10%.

options.name: Gear Slot Percentage
options.doc:
The percentage of items in the item pool that will end up being Extra Gear Slots.
Default is 2%.

options.name: Heart Percentage
options.doc:
The percentage of items in the item pool that will end up being Extra Hearts.
Default is 4%.

options.name: Trap Percentage
options.doc: Percentage of the remaining filler pool replaced by traps.
options.doc_fr: Pourcentage de la réserve de remplissage restante remplacée par des pièges.
